cited.quote: Government hereby constitute a High Level Committee under the Chairmanship of a retired High Court Judge

rationale: The promise does not state the subject the committee is for. C1 constitutes a High Level Committee on the impact of NEET on medical admissions, but nothing in the extracts links that to this commitment's subject. C2-C5 concern unrelated committees.
No extract concerns property tax. C1 extends motor vehicle tax deadlines, C4/C5 extend professional tax deadlines, C2 is a tourism committee and C3 covers petrol tax and SHG loans.

cited.quote: are not able to pay the cane price to the farmers in time

rationale: C5 acknowledges mills cannot pay cane price in time but shows no deadline or enforcement action. C1/C3 concern a production incentive scheme and C2 FRP fixation; none sets a deadline for clearing dues.

cited.quote: Police Note No. SC/20/2021: Transfers and Postings of IPS and non IPS officers
The following Promotions, transfers and Postings are ordered with immediate effect-

rationale: C4 (2021-05-14), C5, C1, C2, C3 order transfers and postings of IPS officers, a realignment of IPS officers. No extract shows a realignment of IAS officers, so only the IPS part is shown.

cited.quote: This Government is committed to expedite the Cauvery-Gundaru link project which was commenced on 9th February, 2009

rationale: C3 (Governor's address) only states a commitment to expedite the link project; no extract shows a government order resuming or expediting it. Other extracts concern roads, DPRs and BharatNet.

cited.quote: reiterated 22 the request for the speedy implementation of the Godavari – Cauvery link scheme to the Union Government

rationale: C3 is the budget speech's water resources section; it mentions a link scheme request to the Union but no budget allocation for the link project works. Other extracts are unrelated (fiscal deficit, KNMT, mining, roads).
No extract concerns construction of the link project. C1, C3, C4 are urban scheme guidelines and C2, C5 are highway road works.
No extract mentions Varummun Kaapom Thittam or its restructuring. C1-C5 concern urban development schemes (KNMT, Namakku Naame Thittam) and the budget speech on urban matters.

cited.quote: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti Corruption (DVAC) will be energized and pending complaints dealt with expeditiously.

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states an intention to energize DVAC; no extract shows guidelines removing interference in the anti-corruption agency. C2-C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti Corruption (DVAC) will be energized and pending complaints dealt with expeditiously.

rationale: C1 is a statement of intent only. C4 posts an officer as DIG in Vigilance & Anticorruption, a routine posting, not an order restructuring or strengthening the agency. No dedicated official measure shown.

cited.quote: This Government will completely overhaul the existing hostels for school and college students

rationale: C2 (budget speech, Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare section) announces a planned overhaul of hostels and a capital allocation; no GO or operational step for hostel infrastructure is shown. C1, C3-C5 are not about this.
No extract concerns dividing town panchayats. C1-C3 are urban scheme guidelines, C4 a grant release, C5 an IT policy note.

cited.quote: This Government will urge the Union Government to devise a permanent solution to repeated instances of assault

rationale: C2 (Governor's address) states the government will urge the Union on assaults and arrests of Tamil Nadu fishermen by the Sri Lankan navy; it is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as a resolution or CM letter. Other extracts unrelated.

cited.quote: this Government will initiate talks with the Government of Kerala to construct the Anamalaiyar dam
This Government will conduct constructive negotiations with Kerala to implement Inter State River Water schemes including the Anaimalaiyar scheme

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) and C2 (budget speech) only state that talks will be initiated; no extract shows negotiations actually commenced. C3-C5 are unrelated agriculture items.

cited.quote: A budgetary provision of Rs.6 crore each has been made for renovation of mosques and churches.

rationale: C3 (budget speech) reports a provision of Rs.6 crore each for mosques and churches, far below Rs.200 crore, and a budget provision is not an operational step. No GO shown.
No extract concerns fees for transfer of assets between blood relatives. C1-C2 are Covid orphan relief, C3-C4 capitation fee committees, C5 health insurance.

cited.quote: Government hereby constitute a High Level Committee under the Chairmanship of a retired High Court Judge

rationale: The promise does not state the goal the committee is for. C1/C4 constitute a High Level Committee on NEET's impact on medical admissions, but no extract links it to this commitment's goal. C2, C3, C5 are policy note and audit text.

cited.quote: will be implemented with renewed vigour with an allocation of Rs.762.23 crore

rationale: C2 (budget speech) says the marriage assistance schemes will continue with an allocation, but no extract shows the assistance raised to Rs.30,000 or 8 grams of gold. C1 only lists the scheme as an online service.
The issues for the camps are not specified. C4 orders special camps for correcting urban land records, not constituency/village panchayat level public engagement camps; other extracts unrelated.

cited.quote: referring eligible in-patients for community-based home delivery for Palliative / Physiotherapy services

rationale: C2 (Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam GO) covers home-based physiotherapy services, a related scheme, not physiotherapy centres in every ward-level hospital. Other extracts are Covid protocols and insurance.
